summary: Champion Homes filed an 8-K reporting the completion of an investor group led by Warburg Pincus acquiring ECN Capital Corp., which owned 49% of Champion Financing LLC, a captive finance company in which Champion Homes holds a 51% interest. The ECN shares converted at C$3.10/share in cash, including Champion Homes' subsidiary-held Series E mandatory convertible preferred shares. Champion expects gross proceeds of C$189.1 million. This is not a transformative M&A event for Champion Homes but rather a consequential third-party transaction involving its joint venture partner. The filing is a status update with no board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock. Watch for any impact on Champion Financing's operations or financing terms resulting from new ownership.
